title: [Prime] Linsoul 7Hz X Crinacle Zero:2 IEM Earphones with Mic 3.5mm $35.99 / USB-C $39.99 Delivered @ LinsoulAudio via Amazon
body:
Deal: [Prime] Linsoul 7Hz X Crinacle Zero:2 IEM Earphones with Mic 3.5mm $35.99 / USB-C $39.99 Delivered @ LinsoulAudio via Amazon

[bogak] Any small portable USB C to 3.5mm audio jack DAC worth getting with these or just any adapter will do?
[YellowWiggle] Also consider the Retro Nano. Great DAC and half the cost of the Qudelix 5X. Shorter battery life but easily swappable.
[beltdrive] Definitely not something you should spend much money on.
There’s diminishing returns beyond a $15 Apple adapter. Just check compatibility first if you have an Android phone
[cactusjuice] I've used the apple dongle on my android before, highly recommend. SNR is excellent for the cost.
[DeToxin] if you want a portable dac with the most user friendly eq and customisation (at least in my experience), get a qudelix 5k, the ability to search for and apply an oratory1990 eq for most headphones is super helpful.
another great cheap pair of earbuds are the akg/samsung ones. with dual drivers their highs and lows are both v nice, specially with eq applied.
[Munki Kundi] Is it the wired akg earbuds?
This one https://amzn.asia/d/05N7PaXo ?
[sintro] I bought this before seems good…
Linsoul Kiwi Ears Allegro Mini Portable IEM DAC, in Ear Monitor Amplifier
https://amzn.asia/d/0fUNmXMa
[ms0308] Would this be cheaper than if I were to buy them from AliExpress or Taobao?
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Anyone running these without a dac? Looking to use with Xbox one controller
[bunnybash] Yup they’re great plugged straight into 3.5mm
[SierraSC] Beware the bone conduction effect when talking with IEMs, ie singing / voice chats
[AustralianCyber] Rumour has it they can hear your thoughts through these mics
[Larsson] Is the usb-c cable version expect digital input and is a dac itself or does it expect an analog output?
[bunnybash] For the price, there’s not much better around. You have to spend a lot more to get something that sounds significantly better. These will be the best sounding headphones that most people have ever heard.
[dealmaker] Woah! Seriously, is this for real?
Are you saying that after convincing myself to go Wireless years after everyone else did it, I now need to reboot and undo to go back to cables for even better sound :).
Noob at this stuff.
[bunnybash] If the source is high quality then yes, this will sound far better than anything blue tooth. Far better.
[nov1911] wireless costs not just money but also sound quality, I know a lot of people don't care at all, ANC and a mic is their biggest factor
it's up to you what to prioritize
[Monfsts123] I think the Linsoul 7Hz X Crinacle Zero:3 is coming out this month.
[marktable] Sound quality is great at this price, but $35 is not a bargain. I got mine under $20 from AliExpress. And I strongly suggest iem fans try some planar driver iems before you reach a conclusion. Some budget planar iems like KZ prx or sgor luna are below $30 when it's on sale on AliExpress.
[StopSpending] How far out of the ears do these stick out? As in, I want to wear them under a tight motorcycle helmet or to sleep. Would they stick out?
[bunnybash] Depends on your ear canal more than anything else. I wear mine under my helmet often fwiw
